english.note: Use 淨係 as the all-purpose choice for “only” or “merely,” including a deliberately low-key “just.”

exampleSentences.english: I just want a glass of water.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jam2 bui1 seoi2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for excluding others or limiting the amount to a stated number.

exampleSentences.english: I only want to have a cup of tea.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jam2 bui1 caa4

english.note: Use this for “simply” meaning only or merely, including when it means alone or without anything added.

exampleSentences.english: I simply want a glass of water.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jam2 bui1 seoi2

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is only or just the case.

exampleSentences.english: I merely want to have a cup of coffee.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that only one thing, person, or material is involved.
Use this when entirely means only or solely, excluding everyone or everything else.

exampleSentences.english: This offer is entirely for members.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個優惠淨係會員有份。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau1 wai6 zing6 hai6 wui6 jyun4 jau5 fan6

english.note: Use this for the limited-scope meaning ‘only’ or ‘just’, rather than for following rules strictly.

exampleSentences.english: This shop strictly takes cash, not electronic payments.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間舖頭淨係收現金，唔收電子支付。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zing6 hai6 sau1 jin6 gam1 m4 sau1 din6 zi2 zi1 fu6

english.note: Use 淨係 for ordinary “only” or “exclusively,” including when highlighting a selected subset such as blazers alone.

exampleSentences.english: For this sale, blazers alone are already thirty percent off.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次做特價，淨係西裝褸都已經平三成。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zou6 dak6 gaa3 zing6 hai6 sai1 zong1 lau1 dou1 ji5 ging1 peng4 saam1 sing4
